articles.title: KPop Demon Hunters Is One Week Away From a Huge Music Record
articles.summary: A K-pop soundtrack has been No. 1 on Billboard's soundtrack chart for 61 weeks — just one week shy of the all-time record. Only one other soundtrack has ever stayed on top longer.

articles.title: These Chairs Grew on Trees (Really!)
articles.summary: In England, Gavin and Alice Munro grow furniture from living trees instead of building it in factories. Their tree-grown chairs take years to make but use way less energy.

articles.title: Carlos Alcaraz Smiled After a 3:34 AM Loss — Here's Why
articles.summary: Tennis star Carlos Alcaraz lost a five-set match at 3:34 a.m. — the latest finish in US Open history. But he walked off smiling because he was just happy to play again after a wrist injury.
